```{r}
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
```


```{r}
ssp1 <- rast("data/wc2.1_2.5m_tmax_MRI-ESM2-0_ssp126_2081-2100.tif")
ssp5 <- rast("data/wc2.1_2.5m_tmax_MRI-ESM2-0_ssp585_2081-2100.tif")
plot(ssp5[[1]])
```

```{r}
world_cities <- read_csv("data/World_Cities.csv")
names(world_cities)
head(world_cities)
```

```{r}
#筛选Japan主要城市
japan_cities <- world_cities %>%
  filter(CNTRY_NAME == "Japan")
```

```{r}
# Create spatial points using Web Mercator
japan_sf <- st_as_sf(
  japan_cities,
  coords = c("X", "Y"),
  crs = 3857
)

japan_sf <- st_transform(japan_sf, 4326)

print(japan_sf)
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = japan_sf, color = "red", size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Major Cities in Japan")
```

```{r}
#提取 sf 空间对象中各个城市的坐标
st_coordinates(japan_sf)

japan_sf$lon <- st_coordinates(japan_sf)[, 1]
japan_sf$lat <- st_coordinates(japan_sf)[, 2]

#从 japan_sf 空间数据中移除几何信息，只保留城市名称、人口、经度和纬度
japan_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(CITY_NAME, POP, lon, lat)
```

```{r}
#检查栅格坐标系
st_crs(japan_sf)
crs(ssp5)
compareGeom(ssp1, ssp5)
```

```{r}
japan_vect <- vect(japan_sf)

japan_vect <- project(
  japan_vect,
  crs(ssp1)
)
```

```{r}
#Extract temperature values at city locations
temp_ssp1 <- terra::extract(ssp1, japan_vect)
temp_ssp5 <- terra::extract(ssp5, japan_vect)
head(temp_ssp1)
head(temp_ssp5)
```

```{r}
# Calculate annual mean maximum temperature for SSP1
ssp1_mean <- rowMeans(temp_ssp1[, -1], na.rm = TRUE)

# Calculate annual mean maximum temperature for SSP5
ssp5_mean <- rowMeans(temp_ssp5[, -1], na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Create a data frame for temperature comparison
results <- data.frame(
  City = japan_sf$CITY_NAME,
  SSP1 = ssp1_mean,
  SSP5 = ssp5_mean
)

# Calculate temperature differences between scenarios
results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    Difference = SSP5 - SSP1
  )

# Display the results
print(results)
```

```{r}
# Sort cities by temperature difference
results_sorted <- results %>%
  arrange(desc(Difference))

# Create the plot
p <- ggplot(
  results_sorted,
  aes(
    x = reorder(City, Difference),
    y = Difference
  )
) +

  # Draw horizontal bars
  geom_col(
    fill = "steelblue",
    width = 0.7
  ) +

  # Add temperature difference labels
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f°C", Difference)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 3.5
  ) +

  # Flip x and y axes
  coord_flip() +

  # Set axis limits
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 3.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  # Add titles and labels
  labs(
    title = "Projected Temperature Difference by City",
    subtitle = "SSP5-8.5 minus SSP1-2.6 | Japan, 2081–2100",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Temperature Difference (°C)",
    caption = "Source: WorldClim CMIP6 climate projections"
  ) +

  # Apply a clean theme
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

  # Customise the appearance
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 15
    ),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      colour = "grey50"
    )
  )

# Display the plot
print(p)
```

```{r}
# Descriptive statistics for SSP1
ssp1_stats <- results %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(SSP1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(SSP1, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(SSP1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min = min(SSP1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(SSP1, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = IQR(SSP1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Descriptive statistics for SSP5
ssp5_stats <- results %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(SSP5, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(SSP5, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(SSP5, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min = min(SSP5, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(SSP5, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = IQR(SSP5, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(ssp1_stats)
print(ssp5_stats)
```

```{r}
# Add scenario labels
ssp1_stats$Scenario <- "SSP1-2.6"
ssp5_stats$Scenario <- "SSP5-8.5"

# Combine descriptive statistics
summary_table <- bind_rows(
  ssp1_stats,
  ssp5_stats
) %>%
  select(Scenario, everything())

print(summary_table)
```

```{r}
# Convert statistics to long format
stats_long <- summary_table %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Mean, Median, SD, Min, Max, IQR),
    names_to = "Statistic",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

# Plot descriptive statistics
ggplot(stats_long,
       aes(x = Statistic, y = Value, fill = Scenario)) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "SSP1-2.6" = "steelblue",
      "SSP5-8.5" = "tomato"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Descriptive Statistics of Projected Temperature",
    subtitle = "Japanese Cities, 2081–2100",
    x = "Statistic",
    y = "Temperature (°C)",
    fill = "Scenario"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(stats_long,
       aes(x = Scenario, y = Value, fill = Scenario)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Statistic,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "SSP1-2.6" = "steelblue",
      "SSP5-8.5" = "tomato"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of Descriptive Statistics",
    subtitle = "SSP1-2.6 vs SSP5-8.5 | Japan, 2081–2100",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Value (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
results_long <- results %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(SSP1, SSP5),
    names_to = "Scenario",
    values_to = "Temperature"
  )

ggplot(results_long,
       aes(x = Scenario, y = Temperature, fill = Scenario)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "SSP1" = "steelblue",
      "SSP5" = "tomato"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Temperature Distribution under SSP1 and SSP5",
    subtitle = "Japanese Cities, 2081–2100",
    x = "Climate Scenario",
    y = "Temperature (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


```{r}
# Calculate monthly mean maximum temperature across cities
monthly_ssp1 <- colMeans(
  temp_ssp1[, -1],
  na.rm = TRUE
)

monthly_ssp5 <- colMeans(
  temp_ssp5[, -1],
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Create a dataframe for monthly comparison
monthly_temp <- data.frame(
  Month = factor(month.abb, levels = month.abb),
  SSP1 = as.numeric(monthly_ssp1),
  SSP5 = as.numeric(monthly_ssp5)
)

print(monthly_temp)
```

```{r}
# Convert data to long format
monthly_long <- monthly_temp %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(SSP1, SSP5),
    names_to = "Scenario",
    values_to = "Temperature"
  )

# Plot monthly temperature comparison
ggplot(monthly_long,
       aes(x = Month,
           y = Temperature,
           color = Scenario,
           group = Scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "SSP1" = "steelblue",
      "SSP5" = "tomato"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "SSP1-2.6",
      "SSP5-8.5"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Mean Maximum Temperature",
    subtitle = "Selected Japanese Cities (2081–2100)",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Temperature (°C)",
    color = "Climate Scenario"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}
jpoutline <- st_read("data/gadm41_JPN.gpkg", 
                      layer='ADM_ADM_0')
```

```{r}
# Plot Japan's national boundary
plot(sf::st_geometry(jpoutline))
```

```{r}
# Convert sf to SpatVector
jp_vect <- terra::vect(jpoutline)

# Check coordinate reference systems
terra::crs(ssp1)
terra::crs(jp_vect)

# Transform boundary to raster CRS if needed
jp_vect <- terra::project(jp_vect, terra::crs(ssp1))

# Crop raster data to Japan's bounding box
jp_ssp1_crop <- terra::crop(ssp1, jp_vect)
jp_ssp5_crop <- terra::crop(ssp5, jp_vect)

# Plot cropped raster
plot(jp_ssp1_crop[[1]])
```


```{r}
# Mask raster cells outside Japan
jp_ssp1 <- terra::mask(jp_ssp1_crop, jp_vect)
jp_ssp5 <- terra::mask(jp_ssp5_crop, jp_vect)

# Compare masked rasters
plot(jp_ssp1[[1]], main = "Japan SSP1 - January")
plot(jp_ssp5[[1]], main = "Japan SSP5 - January")
```


```{r}
# Plot January temperature distribution
hist(
  jp_ssp1[[1]],
  col = "steelblue",
  main = "Japan January Temperature - SSP1",
  xlab = "Maximum Temperature (°C)"
)

hist(
  jp_ssp5[[1]],
  col = "tomato",
  main = "Japan January Temperature - SSP5",
  xlab = "Maximum Temperature (°C)"
)
```

```{r}
# Calculate monthly mean temperature across Japan
mean_jp_ssp1 <- terra::global(
  jp_ssp1, "mean", na.rm = TRUE
)

mean_jp_ssp5 <- terra::global(
  jp_ssp5, "mean", na.rm = TRUE
)

# Create monthly comparison dataframe
jp_monthly <- data.frame(
  Month = factor(month.abb, levels = month.abb),
  SSP1 = mean_jp_ssp1$mean,
  SSP5 = mean_jp_ssp5$mean
)

print(jp_monthly)
```


```{r}
# Extract January temperature values
jan_ssp1 <- as.numeric(
  terra::values(jp_ssp1[[1]], na.rm = TRUE)
)

jan_ssp5 <- as.numeric(
  terra::values(jp_ssp5[[1]], na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Create a dataframe for ggplot
jan_data <- data.frame(
  Temperature = c(jan_ssp1, jan_ssp5),
  Scenario = c(
    rep("SSP1", length(jan_ssp1)),
    rep("SSP5", length(jan_ssp5))
  )
)

# Check the data structure
head(jan_data)
str(jan_data)
```


```{r}
# Create histogram for SSP1
ggplot(
  data = filter(jan_data, Scenario == "SSP1"),
  aes(x = Temperature)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 1,
    fill = "steelblue",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "January Maximum Temperature in Japan",
    subtitle = "SSP1-2.6, 2081–2100",
    x = "Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
# Compare January temperature distributions
ggplot(jan_data, aes(x = Temperature)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 1,
    fill = "steelblue",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Scenario, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "January Temperature Distribution in Japan",
    subtitle = "SSP1-2.6 vs SSP5-8.5, 2081–2100",
    x = "Maximum Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Number of Raster Cells"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Overlay histograms for both scenarios
ggplot(
  jan_data,
  aes(x = Temperature, fill = Scenario)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.5,
    position = "identity",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "SSP1" = "steelblue",
      "SSP5" = "tomato"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of January Maximum Temperature",
    subtitle = "Japan, 2081–2100",
    x = "Maximum Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Number of Raster Cells"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Calculate annual mean maximum temperature
jp_mean1 <- terra::app(
  jp_ssp1,
  fun = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

jp_mean5 <- terra::app(
  jp_ssp5,
  fun = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Plot annual mean maximum temperature
plot(jp_mean1, main = "SSP1-2.6")
plot(jp_mean5, main = "SSP5-8.5")
```

```{r}
# Calculate projected temperature difference
jp_diff <- jp_mean5 - jp_mean1

# Plot temperature difference
plot(
  jp_diff,
  main = "Projected Temperature Difference (SSP5 - SSP1)"
)
```

```{r}
# Extract temperature difference values
diff_values <- as.numeric(
  terra::values(jp_diff, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Calculate descriptive statistics
diff_stats <- data.frame(
  Mean = mean(diff_values),
  Median = median(diff_values),
  SD = sd(diff_values),
  Min = min(diff_values),
  Max = max(diff_values),
  IQR = IQR(diff_values)
)

print(diff_stats)
```

```{r}
# Create dataframe for ggplot
diff_data <- data.frame(
  Difference = diff_values
)

# Plot histogram of projected warming
ggplot(diff_data, aes(x = Difference)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.2,
    fill = "tomato",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = mean(diff_values),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Projected Temperature Difference Across Japan",
    subtitle = "SSP5-8.5 minus SSP1-2.6, 2081–2100",
    x = "Temperature Difference (°C)",
    y = "Number of Raster Cells"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
